title: refactor(types)!: derive the object-form and object-calendar spec keys, rename the legacy zod ActionSchema (#25923)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAakEo5aeRDTLTgR7gcMAuq)_

Part of #25923 (work item 4 only; item 3 and the FormField follow-up stay on the card)

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` already teaches `contentLayout` and `confirmOnDiscard`; object-calendar `locale` and `loading` are taught only by the spec rows' `.describe()` text, with no `skills/**` or `ui/content/docs` page; no `skills/**` page names the zod `ActionSchema`, and the two ui docs pages that imported it are updated in this diff

## 维护者速读

1. 卡面"33 个 spec-only 键"实测是同名碰撞:spec `ActionSchema` 对 objectui 无关的旧 `type: 'action'` 节点 schema。真实配对上的缺口是 11 个键。
2. 4 个有渲染器读取的键按引用派生:`ObjectFormSchema.contentLayout`/`confirmOnDiscard`、`ObjectCalendarSchema.locale`/`loading`(均为节点键,不是 #26411 移走的日历字段名键)。
3. 其余 7 个是 `FormFieldSchema` 上 spec 表单视图条目的键(两层同名词汇),逐键登记在 `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` 的普查里:2 translated、4 carried-not-rendered、1 spec-retired。
4. `@object-ui/types/zod` 的 `ActionSchema` 改名 `CRUDActionSchema`:0 个生产导入方,改名比退役破坏最少;接受集不变。
5. 收窄:旧导出名消失,宽容面对 4 个键的坏值现在按 spec 拒绝 ⇒ `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`、`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`,changeset 带 BREAKING Before/Now/Fix。
6. 门禁:dispatch-gates 34/34 exit 0 已对账;ui vitest(types、plugin-form、plugin-calendar)660/660 文件通过;依赖 `@object-ui/types` 的 39 个包 type-check 108/108 通过。

## Measurement (main `43731031`)

The key-drift probe pairs each `@object-ui/types/zod` mirror with the spec schema of the same export name in `@objectstack/spec/data` ∪ `@objectstack/spec/ui`, and each node mirror with its `ComponentPropsMap` row by `type` literal. A key the spec declares that the mirror neither declares nor refuses is "spec-only".

| Pair | Spec-only keys on main | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `ActionSchema` ↔ spec `ActionSchema` | 33 | Not a pair: objectui's `ActionSchema` is the legacy `type: 'action'` node and shares no vocabulary with the spec's action metadata. This is the card's "33". |
| `FormFieldSchema` ↔ spec `FormFieldSchema` | 7 | Two layers under one name (runtime field vs form-view entry) |
| `ObjectFormSchema` ↔ `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` | 2 | |
| `ObjectCalendarSchema` ↔ `ComponentPropsMap['object-calendar']` | 2 | |
| every other pair | 0 | |

Real gap over the real pairs: **11 keys**. After this PR: **0 unrecorded**, judged by the new census in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.

## Per-key disposition

| Key | Disposition | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectFormSchema.contentLayout` | derived by reference (`SpecObjectFormProps['contentLayout']`, zod `.shape.contentLayout`) | `ModalForm` reads it |
| `ObjectFormSchema.confirmOnDiscard` | derived by reference | `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm` read it |
| `ObjectCalendarSchema.locale` | derived by reference | `plugin-calendar` `resolveAuthoredLocale(rest.locale)` |
| `ObjectCalendarSchema.loading` | derived by reference | `plugin-calendar` `resolveExternalLoading(rest.loading)` |
| `FormFieldSchema.field` | recorded: translated | `normalizeSectionField` writes it as the runtime `name` |
| `FormFieldSchema.helpText` | recorded: translated | written as the runtime `description` |
| `FormFieldSchema.immutable` | recorded: declared, not rendered | copied onto the runtime field; no renderer reads it |
| `FormFieldSchema.keyField` | recorded: declared, not rendered | copied through for the record widget; no widget reads it yet |
| `FormFieldSchema.disclosure` | recorded: declared, not rendered | copied through for composite widgets; no widget reads it yet |
| `FormFieldSchema.precision` | recorded: declared, not rendered | number widgets read `scale` and the object field's metadata |
| `FormFieldSchema.publicPicker` | recorded: spec-retired | the spec's own `retiredKey()` tombstone refuses it with its remedy |

No key needed a new `z.never` refusal: the only retired key (`publicPicker`) is already refused by the spec with its remedy, and objectui's runtime layer never had it.

Seat guard on the two calendar keys: `locale` and `loading` are members the spec authors on the `object-calendar` node and the renderer reads off the node. They are not the calendar field-name keys PR #26411 moved to the hand-off type, so nothing returns to the published face that item 1 took off it.

## ActionSchema: rename, not retire

Importers of the zod `ActionSchema` on main: **0 production**, 7 test files, 2 docs pages. Retiring it would also break the `action` arm of the CRUD discriminated union and the `actions` arrays of `CRUDDialogSchema`, `DetailSchema` and the chain, which all hold it. Renaming changes only the export name, so it breaks fewest. The TypeScript twin keeps its deprecated `ActionSchema` name in `@object-ui/types`.

## What changes

- `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the four keys, by reference on both faces; `ObjectFormSlotKey` carries the two form keys.
- `ui/packages/types/src/zod/crud.zod.ts`, `index.zod.ts`: `ActionSchema` → `CRUDActionSchema`, every internal reference with it.
- Tests: the seven test importers renamed; `object-view-slot-key-lists.test.ts` pins `ObjectFormSchema` at 71 members (was 69).
- Docs: the two pages that import the const.
- `.changeset/25923-spec-only-keys-crud-action-schema.md`: `@object-ui/types` minor, BREAKING Before/Now/Fix.

## Tests

`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` is extended (no new gate) with a census, "every spec-only key over the spec pairs is derived, refused or recorded":

- no spec-only key without a row; no dead row; every reason at least 40 characters;
- non-vacuity: the derived pairs include the four named above;
- identity pins for the four derived keys, and `contentLayout: 'tabs'` refused at path `contentLayout`;
- the zod barrel has no `ActionSchema` and has `CRUDActionSchema`, while `@objectstack/spec/ui` still has `ActionSchema`.

Reverse check: removing the `contentLayout` derivation turns the census red naming `ObjectFormSchema.contentLayout`; restored afterwards.

## Acceptance notes

- `immutable`, `keyField`, `disclosure` and `precision` are copied by `normalizeSectionField` but no renderer reads them. That is recorded here as "declared, not rendered"; no reach was measured, so no card is filed for it.
- ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `runtime-export-retired` would fit better, but that category reads only a package's main entry and refuses an operand declared in a `*.zod.ts`, and this export is on the `./zod` subpath.

- **ADR-0087 marker (seat ruling, 2026-10-27):** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` stands, as on PR #26411. The gate cannot see `@object-ui/types` exports yet, and #26220 (`PACKAGE_ROOTS` omits `ui/packages`) carries that gap.
- **`immutable` is declared on the mirror but not rendered by objectui** (contract review 6445632813 ③.5). It folds into #25923's FormField follow-up and is recorded on the card at landing.

## Verification

Head `38c2841a` (readings below were taken on `96c8d55d`, with `main` `94bab5a2` merged in; `d18ba32e` adds a reasoned `eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-imports` on the census's `import * as SpecUi from '@objectstack/spec/ui'`, the form `spec-ui-schema-reexports.test.ts` uses, which turned Lint UI green; `38c2841a` corrects `enhanced-actions.mdx` to name `CRUDActionSchema`). The vitest, gates and type-check readings below were taken at `b5f1b90b` (before the merge); after the merge, `@objectstack/spec` was rebuilt and `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` re-run under os-verify-lock: 393/393 files, 10691 passed, exit 0. #26365 is still an open draft; it edits `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` in different regions, and whichever lands later merges `main` and re-runs that file.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; every exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first exited 1 on an unbuilt `@objectstack/core` dist in this container, and exited 0 once it was built.
- Under os-verify-lock, `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-form/ packages/plugin-calendar/`: 660/660 files, 13570 passed, 96 skipped, exit 0.
- Under os-verify-lock, `cd ui && pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter='...@object-ui/types' --concurrency=2 --continue`: 39 packages in scope, 108/108 tasks successful, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0 (no anchored file in the change set).
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0.
